info.text:
Renters insurance averages $14 a month. So how do insurers profit?
The average renters premium was $173 a year in 2023, down from $190 in 2014 (NAIC).
It covers your stuff and liability, not the building, so the risk per policy is small.
Allstate's renters, condo, landlord and other personal lines paid 77.4 cents in claims and 16.5 cents in expenses per premium dollar in 2025: about 6.1 cents of underwriting profit.
Sources: NAIC homeowners and renters reports; Allstate 10-K, fiscal 2025.
News and education, not financial advice.
